Your presence on the field of battle is an inspiration to those dedicated to your cause. You can use your Bonus Action to gain the following benefits for 1 hour:

  • You have Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
  • You gain a Heroic Inspiration at the start of every one of your turns if you do not currently have one. Alternatively, you can give a Heroic Inspiration to one ally you can see within 30 ft of you and who does not already have one. You can do so even if you already have a Heroic Inspiration yourself.
  • All allies within 30 ft of you have Advantage on Wisdom Saving Throws.

This effect ends early if you are Incapacitated or die. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).
